test_cmp_tfcode: test the CMP navigation model by running test_cmp_tfcode with a test data directory path
run_cmp_runner_with_goal: run a CMPRunner with a loaded checkpoint and set a new goal vector for navigation
compute_navigation_action: compute a navigation action from a preprocessed image using cmp_runner.compute_action
load_and_preprocess_image: load an image with cv2, resize it, reshape to 4D tensor, and cast to float32
validate_model_actions: validate that model-predicted navigation actions match ground-truth action labels from test filenames
